ops.title: Architecture: one Rust core, three thin hosts — Python inverted from oracle to wasmtime host (0.9.0)
ops.body:
Supersedes the "Python as conformance oracle" architecture (decided 2026-07-18, inverted 2026-07-19 per user request).

**Current shape:** all drift-prone pure logic lives once in sans-io `rust/spawnllm-core` behind `dispatch(op_json) -> result_json` (ops: version, capabilities, plan, resolve, strict_schema, extract_json, retry_decision, auth_probes, claude_isolation_sources/seed). Three thin hosts: the Rust `spawnllm` crate links it natively; Go embeds a wasm32-wasip1 build under wazero (`go/internal/core/core.go`); **Python embeds the same build under wasmtime** (`spawnllm/_core/__init__.py` — lock-guarded singleton, trap → drop instance + re-instantiate, stderr via temp file). Hosts own only I/O: spawn/reap, temp-file materialization of the plan op's `${file:ID}` entries, keychain subprocess, HTTP, retry sleeps, Pydantic/serde validation. MLX stays Python-native.

**Oracle:** `rust/conformance-gen` (workspace bin, publish=false) generates `conformance/vectors/` + `conformance/schema/` from the core; `tests/freshness.rs` is the regen+diff gate (in `cargo test --workspace`). The port produced ZERO vector churn — core was already byte-faithful to the retired Python generator. Replays: Rust native, Go wazero, Python wasmtime (`tests/test_conformance_replay.py`, 118 vectors). Python-side wire_spec (RunSpec→portable dict) is guarded by materialization unit tests in `tests/test_backends.py`, NOT by the replay (replay feeds vector inputs directly). `tests/test_sdk_crosscheck.py` pins core strict_schema against the live openai/anthropic SDK transforms (dev-extra only — the SDKs left runtime deps in 0.9.0).

**Fix discipline is now CORE-FIRST:** edit rust core → `cargo run -p conformance-gen -- --write` → commit vectors + core together → every host inherits via replay. Never hand-edit `conformance/`; never reintroduce portable logic into a host. (The old discipline — fix Python, regen from Python, port to core — is dead.)

**Blob:** never committed (gitignored at `go/internal/core/spawnllm_core.wasm` + `spawnllm/_core/spawnllm_core.wasm`; purged forward-only — history rewrite declined since all blob commits are ancestors of immutable v0.8.0 tags). Built from source everywhere: `task blob` locally, a CI `blob` artifact job feeding test/go/go-lint/vuln, release-pypi via the reusable workflow's `pre-build` input, release-go builds it and cuts a DETACHED blob-carrying commit that the `go/vX.Y.Z` alias tag points at (main never carries the blob; the module zip does). Wheel + sdist ship the blob via uv_build package data (py3-none-any preserved).

Releases stay lockstep on the single `v*` tag (unchanged from [[2ad55473]]-era design).
